verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents a single in-product agent, invoked with the @agent directive. Its docs explicitly scope this to one agent surface per chat session, and no multiple-named-agents feature is documented. Agent Flows and skills extend what that one agent can do, but they do not create separately configured agents with their own prompts and models, and nothing describes routing conversations or channels to different agents.

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each
